# victory-vendor 37.3.6

The published package identifies its author as Formidable, repository as
https://github.com/FormidableLabs/victory, and license expression as MIT AND ISC.
Its original README explains that the project is MIT licensed and its vendored
libraries retain their own licenses. See UPSTREAM-README.md, preserved unchanged.

This exact local package has no top-level LICENSE. Its thirteen original
lib-vendor/*/LICENSE files are included unchanged, retaining their original
copyright notices and terms, including the separately licensed d3-voronoi text.
No generic template has been substituted for an absent original project file.

SOURCE.json binds the package metadata, observed client output and original file
hashes. This is a bounded material attachment, not a complete rendered-vendor
inventory or a declaration that all licensing obligations have been audited.
